name: Resistance Band Bent-Over Row
description: Standing on the middle of a band and hinged forward with a flat back, pull the ends toward your lower ribs, then lower them.

source.title: WorkoutLabs: Resistance Band Bent Over Rows

setup: Stand on the middle of the band, feet shoulder-width apart, holding an end in each hand.
Soft knees, hinge forward with a flat back.
cues: Pull the ends to your lower ribs.
Elbows close, squeeze your shoulder blades.

prescription.note: Pick a band you can pull for every rep with good form. About 2 seconds to pull and 2 seconds to lower.

keyframes.name: Arms hanging
keyframes.cue: Hinged forward, standing on the band.

keyframes.name: Row
keyframes.cue: Pull the band to your lower ribs.
